name: Adi Kesavaswamy Temple, Chebrolu

location.precision: site-level public map reference; current public listing and heritage-coordinate cross-check

history.summary: Adi Kesavaswamy Temple is one of the historic temples documented at Chebrolu. A Government of India tourism/heritage list identifies Sri Kesava Swamy Temple at Chebrolu and dates it to the 11th century A.D.; a separate heritage-coordinate survey identifies Adi Keshava Swamy Devalayam at the same Chebrolu location.
history.founding_period: 11th century A.D. in the Government of India heritage list; chronology is recorded as source-derived rather than independently established by this atlas

name_origin.summary: The public and heritage sources use the names Kesava Swamy and Adi Keshava Swamy for this Chebrolu temple; the atlas preserves both forms rather than selecting an unsupported preferred spelling.

features: Historic Chebrolu temple within a concentrated multi-temple heritage landscape
